dump_results: dump VoteNet detection results including point clouds, proposals, and bounding boxes to a directory as PLY files
dump_results_inference: dump VoteNet inference results to a directory without ground truth labels using the inference switch
softmax: compute softmax probabilities on a numpy array along the last axis for objectness score normalization
review_dump_results: review the dump_results function to understand how it extracts network outputs and writes PLY files
refactor_dump_results: refactor dump_results to use os.makedirs instead of os.system for creating the dump directory
